summary: feat(thunderbird): expose drafts new --body-file and --html to MCP, body-file limited to Documents
reason: Agents need to prepare HTML mails (bold text, identity signature image) with long bodies kept in a file. Both flags were hidden from the MCP schema. --html is a plain boolean and is now exposed; --body-file is exposed too, and under the MCP surface it goes through the same Documents-only final-path guard as --attach (tbResolveMCPFile), so agents cannot read arbitrary local files into a draft. Terminal behaviour is unchanged.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; schema exposure test plus inside/outside/traversal/terminal body-file tests; mutation checks (guard disabled, html re-hidden) detected by the targeted tests
